Please act as a professional verilog designer.

Implement a module of a 64-bit ripple carry adder, which includes several 16-bit registers to enable the 16-bit pipeline stages. The output result is available on the result port, and the o_en = 1 indicates the availability of the result.

Module name:
    adder_pipe_64bit
Input ports:
    clk: Clock input
    rst_n: Active low reset signal
    i_en: Enable signal for addition operation
    adda: 64-bit input operand A
    addb: 64-bit input operand B
Output ports:
    result: 65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb.
    o_en: Output enable signal.

Implementation:
The module includes several 16-bit registers to enable the 4 pipeline stages and synchronize the input enable signal (i_en). These 16-bit registers are controlled by the clock (clk) and reset (rst_n) signals.
The 17-bit sum values for each pipeline stage are calculated by adding the a 16-bit subsection of corresponding input operands and carry signals.
The output enable signal (o_en) is updated based on the pipeline stages and synchronized with the clock (clk) and reset (rst_n) signals.
When the (result) and the (o_en) must be asserted in the same time, at the same clock (clk) cycle.

Give me the complete code.
